# FLOP — public knowledge

> Name: FLOP Network (token: FLOP, pronounced "flop" — one word, never spelled out). Always written FLOP, in capitals; FLOPs is the compute unit, not the name.
> Curated, human-authored answers about the FLOP Network. 38 pages. devnet / next (development).
> Every page here is published-tier: the same text the assistant at https://ask.flop.finance
> is allowed to quote, and the same text it cites.
> Machine interop: https://ask.flop.finance/mcp (JSON-RPC, no auth, rate limited).

- [Proof of Inference (PoI)](https://docs.flop.network/docs/proof-of-useful-inference): PoI replaces arbitrary hashing with real AI inference: a miner runs an agent's session and submits activation commitments plus a co-signed transcript as the proof that validators record and challengers can audit.
- [SOFT and HARD: the two miner hardware tiers](https://docs.flop.network/docs/soft-and-hard-tiers): SOFT is the default tier and needs no attested hardware; HARD is a specified but currently undeployable confidential-computing path with a governed device ceiling.
- [FLOP tokenomics in brief](https://docs.flop.network/docs/tokenomics-basics): The block reward is 96 FLOP, halving every 730 days for five halvings to a 3 FLOP floor and then constant forever; it splits 75% to miners weighted by verified G_n, 10% to the active validator set, 10% to agents and 5% to community stakers, with the last two minted to protocol accounts and not yet distributed.
- [What is FLOP?](https://docs.flop.network/docs/what-is-flop): FLOP is the proof-of-inference blockchain and native currency for the agentic economy: agents pay miners in FLOP to run inference, converting currency directly into compute.
- [Integrating an agent with FLOP](https://docs.flop.network/docs/agent-integration): How an agent posts a session request, what the five request fields are, how it bounds spending with limits, proxies and escrow, and how it challenges work that was not done as asked.
- [FAQ: Competitive Landscape](https://docs.flop.network/docs/competitive-landscape): How FLOP compares to OpenRouter, Bittensor, Pearl, rental marketplaces (Akash, Aethir, Render), and centralised inference providers.
- [FAQ: Demand Side & Broker Architecture](https://docs.flop.network/docs/demand-and-broker): Four demand vectors (orchestrators, aggregators, comparison sites, partnerships), broker USD abstraction and risk hedging, and subsidised compute pricing.
- [FLOP: frequently asked questions](https://docs.flop.network/docs/general-faq): What FLOP is, why agents need it, how the network is put together, what the block reward is, and who governs it.
- [FAQ: Miner & Validator Economics](https://docs.flop.network/docs/miner-and-validator-economics): Miner revenue models, H100 rental economics, 16GB VRAM hardware floor, GPU normalization factors, validator 1.2M FLOP granted bond, and validator node requirements.
- [Mining on FLOP: frequently asked questions](https://docs.flop.network/docs/miner-faq): What a miner stakes, which hardware qualifies, how the 75% miner reward pool is split by verified G_n, what audit exposure the default SOFT tier carries, and why profitability is conditional.
- [FAQ: Team, Leadership & Structure](https://docs.flop.network/docs/team-and-company): Arthur Hayes as founder/CEO, Sergey Vidyuk (CTO), Shu Duan (CSO), Maelstrom funding backing with >2 years runway, and Saint Vincent operating and foundation entities.
- [FAQ: Technology & Chain Architecture](https://docs.flop.network/docs/technology-and-chain): Substrate Layer 1 design, BABE authoring with AlephBFT finality, deterministic settlement, no general-purpose VM, HTLC atomic swaps, and TechnoCore coordination layer.
- [FAQ: Testnet & Launch Timeline](https://docs.flop.network/docs/testnet-and-timeline): Phased rollout timeline: private devnet admissions, public testnet target (Nov 3, 2026), mainnet/TGE (Q1 2027), uncapped testnet participation, and hardware onboarding.
- [FAQ: Tokenomics & Supply](https://docs.flop.network/docs/tokenomics-and-supply): Block rewards, gross 112 FLOP/s emissions, two-year halvings, zero-burn policy, 4.4B genesis airdrop pool, float schedule, earn-to-unlock, and spend-to-unlock mechanics.
- [Running a FLOP validator: frequently asked questions](https://docs.flop.network/docs/validator-faq): What validators do, how the capped 1,000-validator set rotates, what the 10% reward share covers, and how FIP voting works.
- [FAQ: Verification & Security](https://docs.flop.network/docs/verification-and-security): How FLOP prevents GPU spoofing and model substitution through TEE attestation, TOPLOC activation checks, sampled re-execution, and economic slashing without requiring TEE on consumer GPUs.
- [FLOP glossary](https://docs.flop.network/docs/core-terms): Definitions of the terms the FLOP project intro uses: PoI, G_n, SOFT and HARD tiers, TOPLOC, the data-availability layer, session request, FIP, HTLC, and the challenge game.
- [Agent accounts and spend control](https://docs.flop.network/docs/agent-accounts-and-spend-control): The account-based chain gives agents transfers, proxy delegation, staking, vesting, collaborative escrow and a declarative spend-condition layer, so an agent can operate at scale with pre-set spend limits and bounded delegated authority.
- [Cross-chain swaps with HTLCs](https://docs.flop.network/docs/atomic-swaps): Native hashlock timelocks let an agent escrow FLOP against another chain's asset and exchange it once the counter-transfer confirms, powering agent-to-agent sub-economies.
- [How FLOP is governed](https://docs.flop.network/docs/governance): Validators govern through FLOP Improvement Proposals: most FIPs need two-thirds of the active validator set to approve, and through the first halving only the FLOP Foundation may submit one.
- [How blocks are built](https://docs.flop.network/docs/how-blocks-are-built): Validators bundle miners' proof hashes into one-second blocks up to a 2 MB block size limit, and store the model weights sessions depend on in the data-availability layer.
- [How an inference session settles](https://docs.flop.network/docs/inference-session-lifecycle): An agent posts a session request pinning model hash, latency, FLOPs, confidentiality and fee; a capable miner accepts and opens a private connection, returns the proof, and validators fold the proof hash into a block on settlement.
- [Put your GPU to work on FLOP](https://docs.flop.network/docs/run-gpu-provider): A plain-language start for people who own or rent GPUs and are new to crypto: what the machine does, what the account and deposit are, which hardware works, and how to get access.
- [Run a FLOP miner on a GPU host](https://docs.flop.network/docs/run-miner): Current devnet GPU miner setup on an owned or rented GPU host, from host choice and agent-assisted setup to model binding, calibration and readiness.
- [Run a FLOP validator or GPU miner](https://docs.flop.network/docs/run-operator): Choose an operator role, collect the required network inputs, and follow the current validator or GPU miner setup with explicit readiness checks and launch gaps.
- [Run a FLOP validator](https://docs.flop.network/docs/run-validator): Send hostname and public address, receive access and funding, then join the devnet and let operations review activation.
- [Send a request to a specific miner](https://docs.flop.network/docs/send-to-specific-miner): Use the SDK, CLI or local MCP to open, verify and settle a direct session with a named FLOP miner.
- [Staking and slashing](https://docs.flop.network/docs/staking-and-slashing): Miners stake 10,000 FLOP plus capacity-scaled bond and validators stake to join the capped set; provable fraud slashes up to 100% of stake and blacklists the identity.
- [Upgrade FLOP miners, validators, SDKs and agents](https://docs.flop.network/docs/upgrade): The October 2026 devnet release candidate: package versions, compatibility changes, state-preserving operator upgrades, verification and rollback.
- [Cheating must not pay: the challenge game](https://docs.flop.network/docs/verification-stack): FLOP never re-runs inference to trust it: sessions leave commitments that stay challengeable for about seven days, a lottery and bonded disputes re-check slices of the work, and an upheld fraud verdict slashes 100% of the miner's stake.
- [The airdrop and testnet conversion](https://docs.flop.network/docs/airdrop-and-testnet-conversion): Miner airdrop grants are 25% liquid at genesis and unlock the rest one FLOP per FLOP earned serving inference; validator grants stay locked until the first halving, then release one validator per day over 1,000 days; locked agent airdrop can be spent only on compute, and every 3 FLOP of it spent on inference unlocks 1 FLOP; testnet miner conversion allocates from a 1,200,000,000 FLOP pool on verified compute rather than holdings.
- [Official links & verification](https://docs.flop.network/docs/official-links): The canonical list of FLOP's official accounts, domains and contact addresses: there is no FLOP token yet, nothing is trading and there is nothing to buy; where a real contract or claim will be announced; and the current testnet and airdrop status in its target and draft wording.
- [Key protocol parameters](https://docs.flop.network/docs/protocol-parameters): The headline numbers from the FLOP project intro: block time and reward, halving schedule, reward splits, validator set size, miner stake, audit rate, slash tiers, challenge window and dispute bond.
- [SDK and package references](https://docs.flop.network/docs/sdk-references): The FLOP SDKs and tools published on public registries: the TypeScript SDK, gateway client, API contracts, Pi package and CLI on npm, and the Python SDK on PyPI, with versions, install commands, entry points and what each one is for.
- [Operator configuration reference](https://docs.flop.network/docs/operator-config-reference): Generated CLI, environment, and documented RPC names from reviewed public sources
- [Devnet network status](https://docs.flop.network/docs/network-devnet): devnet network readiness and admission
- [Testnet network status](https://docs.flop.network/docs/network-testnet): testnet network readiness and admission
- [Mainnet network status](https://docs.flop.network/docs/network-mainnet): mainnet network readiness and admission
